definitions.conditional_rate: Joint event count divided by scans satisfying the stated agreement definition; null for zero denominator.
definitions.interpretation: Agreement between learned references does not establish accuracy. These auxiliary summaries are not new primary estimands or evidence for recalibration.
definitions.scope: Retrospective descriptive diagnostics from frozen predictions; no fitting, threshold selection or outcome-driven change.
definitions.three_prediction_agreement: max(policy, bank, rich PLS) - min(policy, bank, rich PLS) <= 0.5 pp
definitions.unconditional_rate: Joint event count divided by all scans in the corresponding scored comparison.
